attempts.text:
**The window starts on a two-column spine.** Columns 0 to 1, `glnE` and `hldE`, are carried by 96 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names them in 99.6 to 100% of calls and hesitates by no more than 0.02 bits.

**A short variable pair follows**, columns 2 to 3, in a region of plasticity in 5% of calls, where the model names 64 to 93% of genes. Then a spine, columns 4 to 6, `yqiK` to `glgS`, carried by 91 to 95% of chromosomes, named in 95 to 96% of calls.

**The first fork and variable stretch** runs through columns 7 to 10, in a region of plasticity in 45 to 56% of calls. A second branch of 3 families, in 11% of chromosomes, all shell, runs through columns 8 to 10: a pilus assembly protein, a fimbrial biogenesis chaperone and a fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher protein. Then a spine, columns 11 to 12, `ubiK` and `ribB`, named in 85 to 86% of calls.

**A long spine follows**, columns 14 to 25, `zupT` to `mdaB`, carried by 95 to 96% of chromosomes, named in 63 to 98% of calls. After a fork at column 26 and a spine at columns 27 to 30, columns 31 to 33 mix fork and variable columns, named in 93 to 97% of calls. The spine at columns 34 to 60, `parC` to `gss`, is named in 90 to 98% of calls.

**The window ends in its most hesitant stretch**, columns 61 to 79, fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 54 to 86% of calls. The model names 57 to 88% of genes there; column 62, `yghT`, is the most hesitant at 1.15 bits, and column 63, `yghS`, has the fewest named at 57%. A second branch of 4 families, in 10 to 12% of chromosomes, all persistent, runs through columns 68 to 71: `speC`, `nupG`, `mltC` and `yggX`. The window ends at column 79, `glcG`, in 42% of chromosomes.

label: glnE
facts:
WINDOW: the glnE window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor glnE, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 651 to 730 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying glnE once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,054 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; shell 14,597 calls, named 79%, 0.60 bits; cloud 309 calls, named 18%, 3.63 bits. Outside an RGP 31,400 calls, named 95%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 11,560 calls, named 75%, 0.80 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 15 fork, 15 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.80 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 95%); 11,560 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 62 (yghT) 1.15 bits, RGP 63%; column 63 (yghS) 1.12 bits, RGP 69%; column 61 (pitB) 1.10 bits, RGP 54%. The 22 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.65 bits on average; the other 58 columns: named 94%, 0.20 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 61-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 54-86%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 96-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: glnE, hldE. named 99.6-100% (mean 99.8%), fewest named at column 0 (glnE), named 99.6%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.02 bits (column 0 (glnE)).
2. columns 2-3 (2 columns) variable: RGP 5%. named 64-93% (mean 78%), fewest named at column 2, named 64%; most hesitant at column 3, 0.35 bits.
   2: ibsE S 54% "type I toxin-antitoxin system Ibs f…"
   3: ibsE P 84%
3. columns 4-6 (3 columns) spine: share 91-95%, 2 P, 1 S, RGP 5-6%. Genes: yqiK "flotillin family protein", yqiJ "OB-fold-containig protein", glgS. named 95-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (yqiK), named 95%, 0.38 bits.
4. columns 7-10 (4 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 45-56%. named 75-89% (mean 83%), fewest named at column 8, named 75%; most hesitant at column 9, 0.93 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 8-10, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all S; the branch's families: "pilus assembly protein", "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone", "fimbria/pilus outer membrane usher prot…"
   7 variable: yqiI S 51%
   8 fork: yqiH S 48% "fimbrial biogenesis chaperone"
   9 fork: "FimD/PapC C-terminal domain-containing…" S 45%
   10 fork: ygiL S 56% "fimbrial-like protein"
5. columns 11-12 (2 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 12-15%. Genes: ubiK, ribB. named 85-86% (mean 85%), fewest named at column 11 (ubiK), named 85%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 11 (ubiK)).
6. column 13 variable: RGP 3%. named 95%; 0.09 bits.
   13: yqiD S 84% "protein YqiD"
7. columns 14-25 (12 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0.4-21%. Genes: zupT, ygiD "4,5-DOPA dioxygenase extradiol", ygiC "glutathionylspermidine synthase fam…", ygiB "DUF1190 family protein", tolC, nudF, yqiB "DUF1249 family protein", cpdA, yqiA "esterase YqiA", parE, ygiN "putative quinol monooxygenase", mdaB. named 63-98% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 16 (ygiC), named 63%; most hesitant at column 25 (mdaB), 0.27 bits.
8. column 26 fork: RGP 26%. named 91%; 0.42 bits.
   26: ygiZ S 75% "DUF2645 family protein"; also fitA S 28%
9. columns 27-30 (4 columns) spine: share 94-95%, all P, RGP 15-26%. Genes: qseC, qseB "response regulator", ygiW "OB fold stress tolerance protein Yg…", ygiV "GyrI-like domain-containing protein". named 94-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30 (ygiV), named 94%, 0.29 bits.
10. columns 31-33 (3 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 5-13%. named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 31, named 93%, 0.33 bits.
   31 fork: mqsR S 56% "type II toxin-antitoxin system toxi…"; also fitR S 28%
   32 variable: mqsA S 58%
   33 variable: ygiS S 82% "ABC transporter substrate-binding p…"
11. columns 34-60 (27 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 2-29%. Genes: parC, plsC, ftsP, ygiQ "YgiQ family radical SAM protein", yqhH "lipoprotein YqhH", yqhG "DUF3828 domain-containing protein", dkgA, yqhD, yqhC "DNA-binding transcriptional regulat…", yghB "DedA family protein", metC, exbB "tol-pal system-associated acyl-CoA…", exbD, yghA "NADP(+)-dependent aldehyde reductase", yqhA "TIGR00645 family protein", gpr, yghW "DUF2623 family protein YghW", hybO, hybA, hybB, hybC, hybD "HyaD/HybD family hydrogenase matura…", hybE, hypA, hybG, yghU "glutathione-dependent disulfide-bon…", gss. named 90-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 60 (gss), named 90%, 0.51 bits.
12. columns 61-79 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 54-86%. named 57-88% (mean 79%), fewest named at column 63, named 57%; most hesitant at column 62, 1.15 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 68-71, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-12%, all P; the branch's families: speC, nupG, mltC, yggX
